display.explanation: Ember Days are periods of prayer for the Church’s ministry, both ordained and lay, for vocations, and for those preparing for ordination or commissioning.
display.prompt: Pray for those preparing for ordination, those who guide them, and all who serve in the ministry of the Church.

sentences.label: Sentence
sentences.text: Ask the Lord of the harvest to send out labourers to harvest the crop.

sentences.label: Post-communion sentence
sentences.text: Jesus said, “I appointed you to go and bear fruit, fruit that will last.”

collects.text:
Holy Spirit,
we pray you, comfort and encourage
all deacons and priests
and the men and women soon to find themselves ordained;
may they bring joy and comfort from the Scriptures;
may they bring strength
through the risen body and the saving blood of Jesus.
collects.category: For deacons, priests and those to be ordained

collects.text:
Gracious God,
the giver of all good gifts,
by your Holy Spirit you have appointed
various orders of ministry in your church;
hear our prayers for all deacons and priests
and for those to be ordained to those offices;
maintain them in truth
and renew them in holiness,
that they may faithfully serve you
to the glory of your name
and the good of your church;
through Jesus Christ our Saviour.

Everloving God,
your Son entrusted his followers
with a ministry of love and healing in the world;
inspire the hearts of many
to give themselves to the exercise
of responsible leadership in your church,
that we may witness to your grace
and bring all people within your commonwealth of love;
through Jesus Christ our Redeemer.
collects.category: For lay ministers with particular responsibilities in the church

collects.text:
Praise to you,
God of the eternal promise,
for the caring men and women
who dedicate themselves,
with and through your church,
to bring the gospel to those around them;
may the people hear;
may they hear good news.
collects.category: For lay ministers with particular responsibilities in the church
